title: DataCite
version: 2026-10 faithful rebuild (Public Data Files 2023, 2024, 2025; PID Links 2023, May 2025)
cite_as: DataCite (2023-2025). DataCite Public Data File. https://datafiles.datacite.org/
description: The **DataCite Public Data Files** (CC0) as one range-queryable graph: **109,263,993 DOI records**, one per DOI, and the **PID Graph** (760,802,549 relation events from the 2023 and May 2025 PID Links files), reified as provenance-bearing `dcite:PidRelation`s. Converted by `scripts/datacite/parquet_to_nt.py`; the converter wrote 11,731,454,390 statements.
## What is in it

- One `dcite:Resource` per DOI at `https://doi.org/{doi}`, typed by its resourceTypeGeneral (all 32 DataCite 4.6 values), with title, publisher, publication year, dates, version, language, landing page, usage metrics (2024+), subjects, reified creators (`dcite:AgentRole` held by an `https://orcid.org/` agent when the ORCID is valid), funders (`dcite:fundedBy`) and DOI-typed related identifiers as typed edges.

- The PID Graph: every event is a direct typed edge **and** a `dcite:PidRelation` with `relationSubject`, `relationObject`, its exact `relationType`, `assertedBy` (the source) and `occurredAt`. Events from both PID Links files are kept; an event present in both collapses into one `dcite:PidRelation`.
- Works key by DOI and people by ORCID, so the graph joins crossref, opencitations, openaire, dblp, zenodo and orcid by IRI.
## One record per DOI, and where it came from

DataCite published three snapshots. Each DOI is converted **once**, from the newest file that has it (R9), and within one file from the row with the latest `updated` (R10: 728 DOIs in 2024, 3 in 2025). `dcite:fromSnapshot` says which file:
- `dcite:snapshot-2025`: 108,468,903 records
- `dcite:snapshot-2024`: 308,793 records whose DOI is not in the 2025 file
- `dcite:snapshot-2023`: 486,297 records whose DOI is in neither later file

Filter with `?r dcite:fromSnapshot dcite:snapshot-2025` for the 2025 state only. The 2026-07 build emitted every row of all three files, so a DOI present in several years carried several titles, creators and relation sets at once; that is gone.
## Conversion rules and what each did

The principle is **faithfulness**: the graph says what DataCite says. An identifier is rewritten only when the rewrite is deterministic and names the same thing (`https://doi.org/10.x/y` is the DOI `10.x/y`); anything that cannot be made a valid IRI that way is **dropped and counted**, never guessed. Literals are never cleaned. Counts are occurrences, summed over all five files.
| Rule | What it does | Rescued | Encoded | Kept as text | Dropped |

| R1 | One DOI normaliser for related identifiers, funder ids and link endpoints: strip doi.org / dx.doi.org URL prefixes, `doi:`, `doi/`, `org/`, a leading `%20` / `%7C%5D`, spaces inside the `10.NNNN` prefix. Lower-case (DOIs are case-insensitive). | 173,978,334 | 0 | 83 | 0 |

| R2 | Percent-encode what RFC 3987 forbids (`[ ]`, a second `#`, a stray `%`, U+FFFD, C1, private-use, noncharacters) exactly as `rete export --sanitize-iris` does; a valid IRI never moves. Every IRI is then checked by oxiri (pyoxigraph); one it still rejects is dropped. | 0 | 302,503 | 0 | 0 |

| R3 | Funder IRI: ROR (check digits must pass) > Crossref Funder ID (`10.13039/…`, also a bare Funder Registry number) > a record-scoped IRI `<doi>/funder/<sha1(NFC(name))[:16]>`. The name is always kept as `dcite:agentName`, never truncated. | 13 | 0 | 200,193 | 0 |
| R4 | A funder name that is empty or `#PLACEHOLDER_PARENT_METADATA_VALUE#` is not a name; a reference with neither a name nor a usable id is dropped. | 0 | 0 | 0 | 20 |
| R5 | A link endpoint with no scheme is rescued by R1 or dropped (with its whole event); a URL the IRI parser rejects is dropped. | 84 | 0 | 0 | 460 |

| R6 | `hdl:` -> `https://hdl.handle.net/`. An `https://orcid.org/` IRI is minted only when the ISO 7064 mod 11-2 check digit passes (16 digits without hyphens are re-hyphenated); a creator's failing value is kept as `dcite:rawIdentifier`, a link URL that fails is kept verbatim. | 14,666 | 0 | 14,944 | 0 |

| R7 | All 38 DataCite 4.6 relationType values have their own property, for metadata and PID links alike; `is-funded-by` is `dcite:fundedBy`, `is-authored-at` / `is-affiliated-with` have their own properties; any other link type is `dcite:isRelatedTo` and keeps its exact type on the reified `dcite:PidRelation`. | 28,884,493 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| R8 | A DOI-typed related identifier with no DOI after R1 is dropped; a DOI inside other text is taken only when exactly one stands there, not glued to other characters. | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1,204,136 |
| R9 | One record per DOI: the 2025 file wins, else 2024, else 2023; `dcite:fromSnapshot` names the file each record came from. | 0 | 0 | 0 | 124,087,770 |
| R10 | Within one file, the row with the latest `updated` wins. | 0 | 0 | 0 | 731 |

| R11 | `occurredAt` `0000-01-01` (DataCite's 'unknown') is not emitted. A publicationYear outside 1000-2027 is kept as `dcite:publicationYearText`, not typed `xsd:gYear`. | 0 | 0 | 271,014 | 27,894 |
| R12 | `landingPage` is typed `xsd:anyURI` only when it parses as an IRI; otherwise it is kept as a plain string. | 0 | 0 | 10,624 | 0 |

| R13 | Literals are written as DataCite has them: no trimming, no Unicode normalisation, no mojibake repair (U+FFFD and double-encoded UTF-8 are upstream). C0 controls are written as N-Triples `\u` escapes, not removed. | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| R14 | `rorId` only when the ROR check digits pass; otherwise the value is kept as `dcite:rawIdentifier`. | 51,705 | 0 | 8,438 | 0 |

For R9 and R10, *Dropped* counts metadata **rows** not converted because a newer row of the same DOI was (no DOI is lost); for R7, *Rescued* counts relation edges that use a property this build added.

R7 in numbers: 28,884,493 relation edges now use one of the properties added in this build (they were dropped, or for links folded into `isRelatedTo`, before); 96,221 link events carry a type outside the DataCite 4.6 vocabulary and are `dcite:isRelatedTo` with their exact type on the `dcite:PidRelation`.
R3 routes: 770,898 ROR, 85,070,425 Crossref Funder ID / DOI, 1,420,042 name-minted.
The full per-file tally, with examples of every rescued, kept and dropped shape, is `datacite.tally.json` beside this file.
## Not converted

Related identifiers that are not DOI-typed (URL, Handle, ISSN, arXiv, PMID, …), descriptions/abstracts, typed dates, rights, contributors other than creators, geo locations, sizes and formats are in the Parquet but not in this graph.
## Build

`parquet_to_nt.py emit | rete build - --strict --memory-budget-mb`, so the build refuses any IRI the N-Triples grammar or RFC 3987 rejects; every emitted statement was also parsed by Oxigraph 0.5.11 before the build. Ontology `dcite:` 1.1.0 (`https://w3id.org/rete/datacite#`, OWL 2 QL-safe) travels in the file. No pyramid at this scale: keep queries selective.
